questions.question: A right-angled triangle has hypotenuse 7 and one leg 4. Find the other leg in surd form, showing the working.
questions.expected_answer: The missing side is a leg, so subtract: a squared equals 7 squared minus 4 squared, which is 49 minus 16, giving 33. So a equals the square root of 33, which has no square factor and stays as it is, about 5,74.

questions.question: Simplify the square root of 72 and explain the method.
questions.expected_answer: Find the largest square factor of 72, which is 36, so 72 is 36 times 2. The square root of 72 equals the square root of 36 times the square root of 2, which is 6 root 2. Check: 6 squared times 2 is 72.

questions.question: How is the height of an equilateral triangle of side 80 found, and what is it?
questions.expected_answer: Drop a perpendicular from the apex to the midpoint of the base, making a right-angled triangle with hypotenuse 80 and base 40. Height squared equals 6 400 minus 1 600, which is 4 800, so the height is the square root of 4 800, which simplifies to 40 root 3, about 69,3.
